integration_goal: maximize defensible integration across the eight permanent operational lanes A-H around the same useful-output and total-cost mission without forcing scientifically meaningless coupling

C.primary: state, RAM, VRAM, HBM, storage and data movement

E.primary: materials, biomass, energy, cooling and infrastructure

F.primary: economics, benchmarks, evidence and integration accounting

G.primary: manufacturing equipment, factory software and production systems

pair_review_rule: Every integrated batch reviews all 28 unordered pairs among permanent operational lanes A-H for meaningful coupling. A pair may be marked N/A with rationale; artificial integration is not required.
evidence_rule: cross-lane synthesis may not promote weaker evidence to a stronger evidence class

I_FIELD_AGNOSTIC_CONTACTLESS_VEHICLE_LEV.primary_domain: field-agnostic contactless vehicle lift, propulsion and matched mission energy/noise contracts
I_FIELD_AGNOSTIC_CONTACTLESS_VEHICLE_LEV.ownership_rule: Retain historical artifacts and research. Every new substantive artifact must have one primary owner in A-H and stable cross-lane interfaces; do not delete or silently relabel historical Lane I work.
